registered_lever: source-identity / lineage resolution (DOI<->arXiv mapping, case-insensitivity, publisher prefixes, URL vs bare identifier)
forbidden_lever: any change to the hard-gate threshold, formula, or denominator

gate_slot_declared_before_run.slot_justification: distinct_canonical is the same slot the v1 normalizer filled; swapping the normalizer under a fixed slot keeps the comparison apples-to-apples. distinct_roots is reported as a secondary diagnostic only and MUST NOT feed the gate.

arms.v1_baseline: lower().replace('?v=','').replace('doi:','').replace('arxiv:','') then sha256 - transcribed verbatim from the frozen parent harness, re-executed in-process so the before/after delta is attributable to the normalizer alone

controls_asserted_before_attack_result.expectation: 8 genuinely distinct sources stay 8 distinct canonical identities under v2
each planted near-miss pair (adjacent DOI, same-author arXiv pair, identity-bearing URL query, DOI supplement suffix, v1-collision pair) resolves to 2 distinct canonical identities under v2
arXiv v1 and v2 of one work are 2 distinct canonical identities and 1 lineage root
the v1 baseline over-merges at least one near-miss pair, proving the control can fail and is not a no-op
7 trivially-equivalent surface forms of one DOI collapse to exactly 1 canonical identity (positive-collapse control; the counterpart to C1's no-false-merge assertion)

attack_corpus_source: verbatim submission_details[].evidence_id from the frozen parent RESULTS.json (10 entries, order preserved)
cross_venue_boundary: arXiv:1234.5678v1 is asserted by a harness comment to be the same work as doi:10.1038/s41586-019-1234-5. Nothing in either identifier supports that. The v2 arm therefore reports the attack result WITHOUT any declared DOI<->arXiv record as the primary result, and reports the with-record variant separately as a diagnostic.

terminal_selector_falsification_check.why: a terminal selector that has only ever taken its pass branch is unvalidated; each failure branch was forced once with a throwaway mutation and then reverted

branches_observed.mutation: v2_distinct replaced by len({s.strip().lower() for s in identifiers}) so opaque ids over-merge
v2 attack gate fed a hardcoded distinct_count of 9
baseline replace('?v=') changed to replace('?v=1') so the v1 arm no longer yields 8
